title: Certify the Codec signed seed boundary by kernel-level bit identities
description: Use a generic structural fold-injectivity proof over the two-word state. Prove rotation, doubled XOR-shifts and sign extension from individual bit identities without compiled Boolean evaluation. Verify the original seed overloads and normalized bytecode for the shared 386-instruction body and its two helper methods. Keep the false empty-slice digest as a negative control.
expected: All 128-bit seed and round-injectivity theorems check with standard kernel axioms and the wrong seed identity is rejected.
